assets.dataset: ImageNet-1K original train; 256 ADM center crop + random flip

sampling.nfe: adaptive; saved output points are not model evaluations; measure actual calls

changes: RGB patch4 packed PixelFlow transformer replaced by common latent patch2 DiT with the author PixelFlow positional rule.
Retain four-stage endpoint/clock and equicorrelated boundary noise; unpacked stage minibatches replace mixed-resolution packing.
Use the released adaptive Dopri5 backend and tolerances; common CFG=1 retains the author doubled-state arithmetic. No author best-FID claim.

User-selected RDD rule: visit every training phase for each image; sum phase mean losses with coefficient1, no 1/K or stage-probability factors; one optimizer/EMA update after microbatch accumulation. This intentionally changes the author outer training objective/estimator.
common_contract: Common ImageNet-256 class conditioning, SD-VAE-ft-ema, shared DiTMultiRes-XL/2 backbone, AdamW and 400K updates.
Equal data exposure is fixed; equal updates are NOT equal FLOPs. Record training compute/time and compare inference quality versus measured cost.
This frontend uses one process, micro32 and accumulation8 for global256. Historical RDD used 8 ranks x32; RNG/data order and FP summation are not claimed identical.
Main files are preregistered starting candidates, not already tuned best-performing configurations.
comparison.selection: Use validation data and an equal tuning-compute budget; do not select on final test scores.
comparison.evaluation: Primary CFG=1; 50K generated RGB, same ADM reference and preprocessing. Metrics are a separate evaluation step.
comparison.runtime_scope: CPU/single visible GPU CLI; existing device guard is retained; no GPU authorization in this file.

position.scope: Author integer token coordinates and Diffusers0.32 2D RoPE; evaluated on the new latent patch2 grid.

training_aggregation.name: rdd_sum_stage_means
training_aggregation.noise_policy: Existing declared process noise coupling retained; this change concerns aggregation only
